violations.description: Reheating food. — --Potentially hazardous food was not reheated rapidly so all parts reached a temperature of 165F for 15 seconds within one hour. -Fresh gravy and leftover gravy placed together into dispenser warmer at ~10:30 am, found with temperature of 139F at 11:30 am. *Had staff turn up thermostat to finish reheat throughout product to 165F BEFORE 12:30pm -confirmed at 167F before departure.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Dried food debris at can opener blade. -Dried food debris and cloth fuzz at caramel dispenser. -Pink debris at back and sides of ice chute dispenser at public soda machine.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Debris/residue in cake station cabinet near entrance. -Food spill/debris at vanilla ice cream machine interior and gaskets. -Residue debris at vanilla/chocolate ice cream machine door gaskets. -Build up of frost and food spill/debrisge at drive through refrigerator and freezer. Freezer gasket broken and hangling loose. -table top behind drive through touch screen. -walk in cooler fans

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. -Hand sink at cook line is out of order. *Plumber was contacted last week but has not yet made repairs.

Toilet facilities. — --*Toilet room was not clean or kept in good repair. -Worn/damaged grout at toilet base in women's restroom. -Drain/sewer odor in women's restroom. -Men's restroom toilet in need of cleaning.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. -Unsealed wood slats below ice cream cases in walk in cooler.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Debris build up below shelves in walk in cooler and walk in freezer.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --employees' clothing/possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. -Jacket and sweater on top of case of food at cake prep area. -Jacket and bag on counter top below licenses.
Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Boxes of food being stored on the walk-in cooler floor.

Cooling of potentially hazardous food. — --Cooked potentially hazardous food was not cooled properly from 140F to 70F or below within two hours. Gravy in the walk-in cooler measured at 103 degrees, employee said it had been removed from heat at approximately 10am. Directed to dispose of product immediately.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. A pan is being used to hold up 1 side of the freezer in the kitchen. Knob on the cheese dispenser was held together with tape.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Single use food containers placed on top of the equipment in the kitchen have the food contact surface facing up and need to be inverted.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. Bare wood shelves holding food in the walk-in cooler are not easily cleanable and non-absorbent.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors underneath the shelving in the dry storage, walk-in freezer, and walk-in cooler need to be cleaned. Floors underneath the kitchen equipment need to be cleaned.
